asi.what_failed: Three failure modes intertwined: (1) Training set too small — 3 groups dropped from 30 due to time budget. Too biased toward already-wasteful tasks (rolling_max/etc were fast and we never trained on them). (2) Multi-turn token-masking bias — gradient leaked through tool-result tokens, fuzzing the signal. (3) Adapter generalized 'be efficient' as 'use the bash tool more carefully' rather than 'use fewer total tools' on the easy cases. The 4 strong per-task wins on hard tasks vs 4 strong losses on easy tasks netted near-zero composite movement.
